✨ Prompt API Playground

This is a demo of Chrome's built-in Prompt API powered by Gemini Nano.

How It Works

The Prompt API is a browser-native AI capability that runs Gemini Nano directly in Chrome - no server required!

  • 100% Client-Side: All inference happens locally on your device
  • Privacy-First: Your prompts never leave your browser
  • Zero Latency: No network round-trips to cloud APIs
  • Free: No API keys or usage costs

Key API Methods:

// Check availability
const status = await LanguageModel.availability();

// Create a session with system prompt
const session = await LanguageModel.create({
  systemPrompt: "You are a helpful assistant.",
  temperature: 0.7,
  topK: 3
});

// Stream responses token-by-token
for await (const chunk of session.promptStreaming(prompt)) {
  console.log(chunk); // Real-time output!
}
